commits.author: Thomas Skjølberg
commits.message:
fix: Fix jacoco report (#377)

* Fix jacoco report - remove duplicate file names (although in seperate modules)

* Fix broken root jacoco:report-aggregate execution

report-aggregate was bound at the root pom, but the root has no real
<dependencies> on reactor modules (only <dependencyManagement>), so it
could never find their exec/class data and silently produced an empty
'0 of 0' report. Adding real <dependencies> to the root pom to fix this
was tried and rejected: they are inherited by every child module and
break the build.

- Replace the root's report-aggregate execution with the plain 'report'
  goal, which works correctly per-module (each module reports on its
  own exec/class data with no cross-module dependency requirement).
- Add .github/scripts/jacoco-flat-report.sh, which uses the standalone
  jacococli.jar CLI to build one accurate report across all modules'
  exec/class/source data, correctly attributing cross-module coverage
  (e.g. jwt-spring-web/jwt-spring-webflux tests exercising
  jwt-spring-common) that a per-module report cannot show.
- Wire this script into a new coverage-report job in both
  master-verify.yml and pr-verify.yml, uploading the report as a build
  artifact.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Add CHANGELOG entry for jwt-spring-webflux class renames

Documents the breaking rename of 3 public classes in jwt-spring-webflux
(EnturAuthorizeHttpRequestsCustomizer, EnturOauth2ResourceServerCustomizer,
IssuerAuthenticationManagerResolver -> Reactive* equivalents) done to
resolve FQCN collisions with jwt-spring-web that were blocking accurate
JaCoCo coverage reporting.

Versioning for this repo is done via git tags at deploy time
(entur/gha-maven-central maven-publish.yml, version_strategy: tag), not
via the pom.xml version property (which stays 0.0.0-SNAPSHOT), so no
pom.xml version bump is needed here - select 'minor' on the next manual
deploy-manual.yml run to match this 6.1.0 entry.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Update CHANGELOG for class name changes in 6.1.0

Renamed classes in jwt-spring-webflux to avoid name collisions.

---------

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
